## Generate signals

```{python} 
# Imports
from freqtrade.configuration import Configuration
from freqtrade.data.dataprovider import DataProvider
from freqtrade.data.history import load_pair_history
from freqtrade.enums import CandleType
from freqtrade.resolvers import StrategyResolver
import plotly.graph_objects as go


def show(fig):
    fig.update_layout(dragmode="pan")
    fig.show(config={"scrollZoom": True})


print("Loading done")
```
```{python} 
# Setup
root_path = "/home/gustav/projects/freqtrade_dir"

config = Configuration.from_files([f"{root_path}/user_data/config.json"])
config["timeframe"] = "1d"
config["strategy"] = "SimpleSMA"
config["dataformat_ohlcv"] = "feather"
pair = "BTC/USDT"
```

```{python} 
# Load candles
candles = load_pair_history(
    datadir=config["datadir"],
    timeframe=config["timeframe"],
    pair=pair,
    data_format=config["dataformat_ohlcv"],
    candle_type=CandleType.SPOT,
)
```

```{python} 
# Load strategy
strategy = StrategyResolver.load_strategy(config)
strategy.dp = DataProvider(config, None, None)
strategy.ft_bot_start()

# Generate buy/sell signals using strategy
# NOTE: can have several signals in a row, only limited by max_open_trades
df = strategy.analyze_ticker(candles, {"pair": pair})
```

```{python} 
# Report results
data = df.set_index("date", drop=False)
data.tail()
```

```{python} 
# Plot entries/exits
fig = go.Figure()

fig.add_trace(
    go.Scatter(
        x=data["date"],
        y=data["close"],
        mode="lines",
        name="Close",
        line=dict(color="steelblue"),
    )
)

fig.add_trace(
    go.Scatter(
        x=data["date"],
        y=data["buy_sma_40"],
        mode="lines",
        name="Close",
        line=dict(color="steelblue"),
    )
)

entries = df[df["enter_long"] == 1]
fig.add_trace(
    go.Scatter(
        x=entries["date"],
        y=entries["close"],
        mode="markers",
        name="Enter Long",
        marker=dict(symbol="triangle-up", size=10, color="lime"),
    )
)

exits = df[df["exit_long"] == 1]
fig.add_trace(
    go.Scatter(
        x=exits["date"],
        y=exits["close"],
        mode="markers",
        name="Exit Long",
        marker=dict(symbol="triangle-down", size=10, color="red"),
    )
)

fig.update_layout(
    title="Close Price with Signals", xaxis_title="Date", yaxis_title="Price"
)
fig.show()
```

## Analyse backup
```{python} 
# Imports
from freqtrade.data.btanalysis import load_backtest_data, load_backtest_stats
from freqtrade.optimize.optimize_reports import show_backtest_results
import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px
```

```{python} 
backtest_dir = "/home/gustav/projects/freqtrade_dir/user_data/backtest_results"
```

```{python} 
# Load backtest stats
stats = load_backtest_stats(backtest_dir)

strategy = "SimpleSMA"
strategy_stats = stats["strategy"][strategy]

print(strategy_stats["results_per_pair"])
print(strategy_stats["pairlist"])
print(strategy_stats["market_change"])
print(strategy_stats["max_drawdown_abs"])
print(strategy_stats["drawdown_start"])
print(strategy_stats["drawdown_end"])

print(stats["strategy_comparison"])

show_backtest_results(config, stats)

df = pd.DataFrame(columns=["dates", "equity"], data=strategy_stats["daily_profit"])
df["equity_daily"] = df["equity"].cumsum()


fig = px.line(df, x="dates", y="equity_daily")
fig.show()
```

```{python} 
# Load backtest trades

trades = load_backtest_data(backtest_dir)
```

```{python} 
# Plot trades

import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px


from freqtrade.configuration import Configuration
from freqtrade.data.btanalysis import load_backtest_stats
```
```{python} 
# Plot results
from freqtrade.plot.plotting import generate_candlestick_graph

# Filter trades to one pair
trades_red = trades.loc[trades["pair"] == pair]

data_red = data["2020-01-01":"2026-01-01"]
# Generate candlestick graph
graph = generate_candlestick_graph(
    pair=pair,
    data=data_red,
    trades=trades_red,
    indicators1=["sma20", "ema50", "ema55", "buy_sma_40"],
    indicators2=["rsi", "macd", "macdsignal", "macdhist"],
)
show(graph)
```

```{python} 
# Create profit plot
from freqtrade.plot.plotting import generate_profit_graph

graph2 = generate_profit_graph(
    pairs=[pair],  # type: ignore
    data={pair: data_red},
    trades=trades_red,
    timeframe=config["timeframe"],
    stake_currency=config["stake_currency"],
    starting_balance=config["dry_run_wallet"],
)

show(graph2)
```
